company.description:
Tmyyoz is an electronic educational platform that provides educational and technical resources to students.

Tmyyoz was designed to create an enhanced educational experience and assist students in preparing for standardized tests and excelling in their academic curricula, in collaboration with specialized instructors and educators.

It was founded in 2021 and is based in Makkah, Alawali.
